title: Stranded Groceries Surcharge on Dropped Batches, Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts
content:
Under Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts, a dropped batch leaves its groceries to be re-offered, and the dropped-batch violation carries a stranded-items surcharge sized by the item units the batch carried, as its record in Cartwise Shopper Batches shows.

**Clause.** 60 or more item units add 2 points; from 30 up to 59 item units (one fewer than 60) add 1 point; fewer than 30 add nothing.

## Ladder

| Item units on the dropped batch | Stranded-items surcharge |
|---|---|
| 60 or more | 2 points |
| 30 to 59 | 1 point |
| 0 to 29 | Nothing |

## Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical batches)

| Item units | Surcharge |
|---|---|
| 60 | 2 points |
| 59 | 1 point |
| 30 | 1 point |
| 29 | Nothing |

The figure is the item-unit count on the batch record: a hypothetical batch carrying 32 item units adds 1 point.
